#249 · Diving Pokémon

Lugia

Psychic Flying

Johto · Generation 2 · Legendary Pokémon

Lugia is a Psychic/Flying-type Diving Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 5.2 m tall and weighs 216 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (154), with a base stat total of 680.
